assumptions: 1/2/3 brake events per lap are deliberately assumed; no measured electrical braking interval is published here.
2s brake command hold is a sensitivity assumption, not extracted from the paper.
0.1s sponge-contact time in the paper is not used as electrical brake duration or interval.
Each event resets the current to5/10A, assuming drive/re-acceleration between events; not a measured vehicle history.
ThetaJA52/137C/W and thermal time constants1/10/100s are unverified for this PCB.
Rds=.017*2ohm and40C ambient are assumptions, not full-temperature guaranteed loss.
Free decay and externally sustained generation are distinct conditions.
Steady periodic temperature is calculated analytically from the first-order thermal map; actual multicell thermal path is not modeled.
Standalone30s free/forced brake cases are in brake-heat.json; long overlapping commands are not reset into artificial new motor-current pulses.
